guide: Open Start and type your studio name and your own limits in the yellow cells: mark-up, reserve, target margin, item margin share, long-lead weeks, sample days and waste share.
Check Projects, Rooms (Room budgets) and Vendors. They hold the projects, the approved room budgets and the vendors that every other sheet looks up.
Fill Mark-up rules with the standard and the minimum mark-up of each category and the rounding step; Discount tiers with the extra discounts each vendor gives.
Enter each item on FF&E schedule: project, room, vendor, quantity, list price, trade discount and mark-up. Unit cost, client price, margin and the checks fill in.
Watch Room budgets and Project budgets: the specified total, what is left, the over-budget check and the reserve update with every item you add.
Use Budget by category and Allowances to compare the specification with the category shares and with the allowance agreed with the client.
Log asks on Specification approvals, samples on Finish and samples, and stuck items on Decisions. Days waiting and the checks show what to chase.
Record each Substitutions row and each Alternatives option so the price, margin and lead-time effect is clear before you write to the client.
Keep Dimensions, Lighting schedule and Fabric schedule up to date for sizes, watts, metres and order dates.
Use the 14 calculators for prices, mark-up, room and category budgets, substitutions, quantity tiers, fabric, flooring, lighting, rounding, cuts, the reserve and what-ifs.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Specification Dashboard and Charts every week: specified value, margin, rooms over budget, substitutions, samples and items waiting.

listing.title: Interior Designer FF&E Schedule and Room Budget Excel Template: Trade Price, Mark-up, Margin, Substitutions, Fabric Metres, Lighting
listing.headline: Specify every item and keep every room on budget
listing.description:
Run the specification side of an interior design studio in one Excel workbook. The FF&E schedule (furniture, fittings and equipment) holds every item with its vendor, quantity, list price, trade discount (the discounted price a vendor gives a design professional) and mark-up, and calculates the unit cost, the client price, the margin and the margin share, with checks for approval before the order, long lead times, missing vendors and items under your target margin.

Room budgets and Project budgets compare what is specified with what each room and each project may spend, show the share used and what is left, and tell you when a room is within budget, inside your reserve or over. Budget by category and Allowances show where the specification drifts from the shares you planned and from the allowance you agreed with the client.

Substitutions and Alternatives price every change before you write to the client: the trade price change, the client price change, the lead-time change and one recommended option. Finish and samples tracks days to receive and the client decision; Decisions lists the items that are stuck and for how many days.

Mark-up rules, Discount tiers, Room benchmarks, an Item library of 90 reusable items, Dimensions, a Lighting schedule with watts and dimmers and a Fabric schedule with metres, waste, cost and order dates complete the studio's specification files.

14 calculators cover trade and client price, mark-up for a target margin, room and category budgets, specified against budget, substitution effect, price at a quantity, fabric metres, rug and flooring quantity, lighting load, price rounding, budget cuts, the contingency reserve and a mark-up and discount what-if grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready text messages that open with the details already written in.

This is part three of the Interior Designer suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for a small design studio to explore first. It helps you plan your specification and budgets; it does not replace advice on contracts or tax.

messages.moment: Client: your room items are ready
messages.text: Hello, the item specification for {room} in {project_name} is ready to approve. It stands at {specified} against a budget of {budget}. May we go through it together?

messages.moment: Client: please approve an item by
messages.text: Hello, please approve or choose {description} by {due_date}. Without your answer the delivery date may move.

messages.moment: Client: items in a room need approval
messages.text: Hello, a reminder: {items_waiting} items in {room} still need your approval. The specification is due on {spec_due}.

messages.moment: Client: your room budget is attached
messages.text: Hello, your room budget for {room} is attached. The approved budget is {budget} for {sqm} sqm, and {specified} is specified so far.

messages.moment: Client: the specification is over budget
messages.text: Hello {client}, the specification for {project_name} is {variance} against the budget. Options to bring it back are inside the report. May we talk this week?

messages.moment: Client: two alternatives for an item
messages.text: Hello, here are alternatives for {description}: {option} from {vendor} at {client_price} per piece, lead time {lead_weeks} weeks. Which one do you prefer?

messages.moment: Client: your sample has arrived
messages.text: Hello, your sample of {material} has arrived at the studio. Please see it by {decide_by} so the order is not delayed.

messages.moment: Client: a substitute is proposed
messages.text: Hello, we propose a substitute for {description}: {new_item}. Reason: {reason}. The price changes by {client_change} and the lead time by {lead_change} weeks. May we go ahead?

messages.moment: Client: approved items go to order
messages.text: Hello {client}, thank you. {items_approved} approved items of {project_name} are released to order. The specification is frozen on {freeze_on}.

messages.moment: Client: confirm the final quantities
messages.text: Hello, please confirm the quantity of {description}: {qty} pieces, {width} by {depth} cm. We order on your confirmation.

messages.moment: Client: your finish choices are due
messages.text: Hello, your finish choice for {material} in the {room} is due on {decide_by}. The vendor needs your decision to hold the lead time.

messages.moment: Client: the price of an item changed
messages.text: Hello, the price of {description} changed. The new price effect for you is {client_change}. We will not order before you agree.

messages.moment: Vendor: please quote an item
messages.text: Hello, please quote {description}, quantity {qty}, for our project {project}. Please include the trade price, the lead time and the delivery cost.

messages.moment: Vendor: please send a sample
messages.text: Hello, please send a sample of {material} for project {project}. We need it by {decide_by} if possible. Thank you.

messages.moment: Vendor: confirm price and lead time
messages.text: Hello {contact}, please confirm our trade discount of {trade_discount} and your current lead time of {lead_weeks} weeks for the coming projects.

messages.moment: Vendor: item discontinued, alternative?
messages.text: Hello, {description} from your range is no longer available to us. Which alternative do you recommend, and at what trade price and lead time?

messages.moment: Vendor: please confirm the fabric stock
messages.text: Hello, please confirm that you have {total_metres} metres of {fabric} from one batch. We plan to order by {order_by}.

messages.moment: Vendor: a project quantity enquiry
messages.text: Hello, a project quantity enquiry: {qty} pieces of {description}. Is there an extra discount for this quantity or for a single delivery?

messages.moment: Owner: a room is over its budget
messages.text: Hello, {room} in {project_name} is over its budget by {over_by}. Specified {specified} against {budget}. Please review before the client sees it.

messages.moment: Owner: a project is above its budget
messages.text: Hello, the specification of {project_name} is {variance} against the approved budget. Budget check: {budget_check}. Reserve left: {contingency_left}.

messages.moment: Owner: an item margin is too low
messages.text: Hello, the margin on {description} in {project_name} is {margin_share}, under the target. Mark-up {markup_pct}. Please check the price.

messages.moment: Owner: items wait for the client
messages.text: Hello, {description} (value {value}) has waited {days_waiting} days for a decision on project {project}. Decision check: {dec_flag}.

messages.moment: Owner: the weekly review is ready
messages.text: Hello, the weekly specification review is ready. {name}: {items_count} items, {specified} specified against {ffe_budget}, {rooms_over} rooms over budget.

messages.moment: Lead: complete the room specification
messages.text: Hello, please complete the specification for {room} in {project_name}. It is due on {spec_due}. {items_waiting} items still wait for approval.

messages.moment: Lead: an item still needs a vendor
messages.text: Hello, {description} in {room} ({project_name}) still has no vendor. Please choose one so we can price it.

messages.moment: Lead: the substitute needs your check
messages.text: Hello, please check the substitute for {description}: {new_item}. Price effect {price_change}, lead time change {lead_change} weeks.

messages.moment: Assistant: request samples for a room
messages.text: Hello, please request samples for {room} in {project_name}. The specification is due on {spec_due}.

messages.moment: Assistant: approved items ready to order
messages.text: Hello, the approved items of {project_name} are ready to order: {items_approved} items. The client has approved them.

documents.title: Substitution notice to a client
paragraphs: Substitution notice of {set:company}, dated {today}. Project {col:subst.project}. Substitution {col:subst.sub_id}.
The item {col:subst.description} from {col:subst.old_vendor} is replaced by {col:subst.new_item} from {col:subst.new_vendor}. Reason: {col:subst.reason}.
Price change at trade level: {col:subst.price_change} ({col:subst.change_share}). Change to your price: {col:subst.client_change}. Lead time change: {col:subst.lead_change} weeks.
Status: {col:subst.status}. Approved by: {col:subst.approved_by}. Please sign to accept the substitution; we will not order the new item before we have your signature.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Lighting schedule line
paragraphs: Lighting schedule of {set:company}, dated {today}. Project {col:lights.project}: {col:lights.project_name}. Room: {col:lights.room}.
Fitting: {col:lights.fitting}, {col:lights.qty} pieces at {col:lights.watts} watts each, {col:lights.total_watts} watts in total. Switch group {col:lights.switch_group}. Dimmer: {col:lights.dimmer}.
Vendor: {col:lights.vendor}. Cost of the fittings at trade level: {col:lights.cost}. Planned on {col:lights.planned_on}.
The electrician checks the loads and the switch groups against this schedule before the first fix.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Fabric and upholstery schedule line
paragraphs: Fabric and upholstery schedule of {set:company}, dated {today}. Project {col:fabrics.project}. Item {col:fabrics.item}: {col:fabrics.description}.

Fabric: {col:fabrics.fabric}. {col:fabrics.metres_per_item} metres for one, {col:fabrics.qty} pieces, {col:fabrics.total_metres} metres to order with waste. Cost: {col:fabrics.cost} at {col:fabrics.cost_per_m} per metre.
Vendor: {col:fabrics.vendor}. Lead time {col:fabrics.lead_weeks} weeks. Order by {col:fabrics.order_by}; the fabric is ready by {col:fabrics.ready_by}. Order check: {col:fabrics.order_flag}.
Order all metres from one batch and keep a cutting from it.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Sample request to a vendor
paragraphs: Sample request of {set:company}, dated {today}. To: {col:samples.vendor}. Project {col:samples.project}: {col:samples.project_name}.
Please send a sample of: {col:samples.material}. It is for the {col:samples.room}. Requested on {col:samples.requested_on}. We need it within {set:sample_days} days.
Please confirm that the trade price and the lead time have not changed, and tell us if the finish is discontinued or on back-order (not in stock, new date promised).
Please send the sample to the studio address and mark it with the project number.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Budget against specified report
paragraphs: Budget against specified report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Project {col:pbudgets.project}: {col:pbudgets.project_name}. Type: {col:pbudgets.type}.

FF&E budget {col:pbudgets.ffe_budget}; specified at client prices {col:pbudgets.specified}; variance {col:pbudgets.variance} ({col:pbudgets.variance_share}). Budget check: {col:pbudgets.budget_check}.
Trade cost of the specified items: {col:pbudgets.trade_cost}. FF&E margin: {col:pbudgets.margin}. Contingency: {col:pbudgets.contingency}, left: {col:pbudgets.contingency_left}.
Rooms over budget: {col:pbudgets.rooms_over}. Items awaiting approval: {col:pbudgets.items_waiting}. Trades budget {col:pbudgets.trades_budget}; design fee {col:pbudgets.design_fee}.
Actions and the person who owns each one are written below.

documents.title: Items awaiting a decision
paragraphs: Decision note of {set:company}, dated {today}. Project {col:decisions.project}. Item {col:decisions.item}: {col:decisions.description}.

Issue: {col:decisions.issue}. Raised on {col:decisions.raised_on}; due on {col:decisions.due_date}. Waiting {col:decisions.days_waiting} days. Owner: {col:decisions.owner}. Status: {col:decisions.status}.
Value of the item at the client price: {col:decisions.value}. Decision check: {col:decisions.dec_flag}.
Until the decision is made the item cannot be ordered and its delivery date may move.

es.Watch Room budgets and Project budgets:: Observe Presupuestos de habitaciones y Presupuestos de proyectos: el total especificado, lo que queda, la verificación de exceso de presupuesto y la actualización de la reserva con cada elemento que agregue.

es.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Edita aquí el texto; las palabras entre {llaves} se completan con los datos de cada fila. Los enlaces están en las tablas.
es.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Elige un registro: cada paso tendrá su fecha límite. Haz una copia de esta hoja para cada caso.

de.Check the margin on every item: Überprüfen Sie den Rand jedes Artikels

de.Prepare two alternatives for the biggest: Bereiten Sie zwei Alternativen für die größten Artikel vor

de.Release the items to the assistant for o: Geben Sie die Artikel zur Bestellung an den Assistenten frei

de.Check the fabric on arrival: Überprüfen Sie den Stoff bei der Ankunft

de.Check that every item has a vendor: Überprüfen Sie, ob für jeden Artikel ein Anbieter vorhanden ist
de.Check the quantities against the plans: Vergleichen Sie die Mengen mit den Plänen

de.Specified against budget by project type: Wird anhand des Budgets nach Projekttyp angegeben
de.Rooms over budget by room type: Zimmer je nach Zimmerkategorie über dem Budget

de.Check Projects, Rooms (Room budgets) and: Überprüfen Sie Projekte, Räume (Raumbudgets) und Anbieter. Sie enthalten die Projekte, die genehmigten Raumbudgets und die Anbieter, nach denen jedes zweite Blatt sucht.
de.Fill Mark-up rules with the standard and: Füllen Sie Aufschlagsregeln mit dem Standard- und dem Mindestaufschlag jeder Kategorie und dem Rundungsschritt; Rabattstufen mit den zusätzlichen Rabatten, die jeder Anbieter gewährt.
de.Enter each item on FF&E schedule: projec: Geben Sie jeden Artikel auf Möbel-, Einrichtungs- und Ausstattungsplan ein: Projekt, Raum, Lieferant, Menge, Listenpreis, Handelsrabatt und Aufschlag. Stückkosten, Kundenpreis, Marge und die Schecks werden ausgefüllt.
de.Watch Room budgets and Project budgets:: Beobachten Sie Raumbudgets und Projektbudgets: die angegebene Gesamtsumme, den verbleibenden Betrag, die Überbudgetprüfung und die Reserveaktualisierung für jeden von Ihnen hinzugefügten Artikel.
de.Use Budget by category and Allowances to: Verwenden Sie Budget nach Kategorie und Zulagen, um die Spezifikation mit den Kategorieanteilen und der mit dem Kunden vereinbarten Zulage zu vergleichen.
de.Log asks on Specification approvals, sam: Protokollieren Sie Anfragen bei Spezifikationsgenehmigungen, Beispiele bei Finish und Muster und hängengebliebene Elemente bei Entscheidungen. Tagelanges Warten und die Schecks zeigen, was zu jagen ist.
de.Record each Substitutions row and each A: Notieren Sie jede Zeile „Ersetzungen“ und jede Option „Alternativen“, damit der Preis, die Marge und die Auswirkung auf die Vorlaufzeit klar sind, bevor Sie dem Kunden schreiben.
de.Keep Dimensions, Lighting schedule and F: Halten Sie die Abmessungen, Beleuchtungsplan und Stoffplan für Größen, Watt, Meter und Bestelldaten auf dem neuesten Stand.
de.Use the 14 calculators for prices, mark-: Nutzen Sie die 14 Rechner für Preise, Aufschläge, Zimmer- und Kategoriebudgets, Ersatz, Mengenstufen, Stoff, Bodenbelag, Beleuchtung, Rundungen, Schnitte, die Reserve und Was-wäre-wenn.
de.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Drucken Sie 10 Blätter und 10 Dokumente aus, folgen Sie 10 Checklisten und tippen Sie auf einen Nachrichtenlink, um einen Text mit den bereits eingetragenen Details zu senden.
de.Read the Specification Dashboard and Cha: Lesen Sie jede Woche die Spezifikations-Dashboard und Diagramme: angegebener Wert, Marge, Zimmer über Budget, Ersatz, Muster und wartende Artikel.
de.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Alle Auswahllisten dieser Datei. Ändere hier einen Eintrag, und er wird in allen Tabellen übernommen.
de.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Wird anhand deiner Tabellen aktualisiert. Ändere das Jahr, um frühere Daten anzusehen.
de.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Wähle die gelbe Zelle aus; der Rest wird automatisch ausgefüllt. Druckbereit.
de.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Bearbeite den Text hier; Wörter in {Klammern} werden aus jeder Zeile übernommen. Die Verknüpfungen findest du in den Tabellen.
de.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Wähle einen Eintrag aus: Für jeden Schritt wird das Fälligkeitsdatum berechnet. Erstelle für jeden Eintrag eine Kopie dieses Tabellenblatts.
de.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Aktuelle Diagramme deiner Tabellen. Wähle die gelben Zellen aus, und alle Diagramme und Messanzeigen werden automatisch aktualisiert.

nl.Rooms over budget: {col:pbudgets.rooms_o: Kamers boven budget: {col:pbudgets.rooms_over}. Items die wachten op goedkeuring: {col:pbudgets.items_waiting}. Handelsbudget {col:pbudgets.trades_budget}; ontwerpkosten {col:pbudgets.design_fee}.
nl.Actions and the person who owns each one: Acties en de persoon die de eigenaar is, worden hieronder beschreven.
nl.Items awaiting a decision: Zaken die wachten op een beslissing
nl.Issue: {col:decisions.issue}. Raised on: Probleem: {col:decisions.issue}. Opgegroeid op {col:decisions.raised_on}; vervalt op {col:decisions.due_date}. Wachten op {col:decisions.days_waiting} dagen. Eigenaar: {col:decisions.owner}. Status: {col:decisions.status}.
nl.Value of the item at the client price: {: Waarde van het artikel tegen de klantprijs: {col:decisions.value}. Beslissingscheck: {col:decisions.dec_flag}.
nl.Until the decision is made the item cann: Zolang de beslissing niet is genomen, kan het artikel niet worden besteld en kan de leverdatum verschuiven.
nl.Open the FF&E schedule for the project: Open de meubilair, armaturen en uitrustingschema voor het project
nl.Load the room list and the room budgets: Laad de kamerlijst en de kamerbudgetten
nl.Agree the mark-up and trade discounts: Ga akkoord met de opslag- en handelskortingen
nl.Set the reserve and the freeze date: Stel de reserve- en de bevriezingsdatum in
nl.Pull reusable items from the library: Haal herbruikbare items uit de bibliotheek
nl.Review the first specification with the: Bespreek de eerste specificatie met de lead
nl.Confirm the room sizes and the budget: Bevestig de kamergroottes en het budget
nl.List every item the room needs: Maak een lijst van elk item dat de kamer nodig heeft
nl.Check sizes against the plan: Controleer de maten volgens het plan
nl.Send the room to the client for approval: Stuur de kamer ter goedkeuring naar de opdrachtgever
nl.Mark-up checked against the rule: Opmaak gecontroleerd aan de hand van de regel
nl.Confirm the vendor shipped it: Bevestig dat de leverancier het heeft verzonden
nl.Receive and label the sample: Ontvang het monster en label het
nl.Check it against the specification: Controleer het aan de hand van de specificatie
nl.Show it to the client: Laat het aan de klant zien
nl.Release the item or ask for another samp: Geef het artikel vrij of vraag om een nieuw monster
nl.Total the specification at client prices: Totaal van de specificatie tegen klantprijzen
nl.Compare each room with its budget: Vergelijk elke kamer met zijn budget
nl.Compare each category with its share: Vergelijk elke categorie met zijn aandeel
nl.Check the margin on every item: Controleer de marge op elk item
nl.Decide what to cut if over budget: Bepaal waar u op moet bezuinigen als u het budget te boven gaat
nl.Prepare two alternatives for the biggest: Bereid twee alternatieven voor voor de grootste items
nl.Record the answer in the schedule: Noteer het antwoord in het schema
nl.Release the items to the assistant for o: Geef de artikelen vrij aan de assistent om te bestellen
nl.Confirm the purchase orders are placed: Bevestig dat de inkooporders zijn geplaatst
nl.Compare the price and the margin: Vergelijk de prijs en de marge
nl.Compare the lead time and the schedule: Vergelijk de doorlooptijd en het schema
nl.Send the substitution to the client: Stuur de vervanging naar de klant
nl.Record the client answer: Noteer het antwoord van de cliënt
nl.Update the schedule and the purchase ord: Update de planning en de inkooporder
nl.Mark every fitting on the plan: Markeer elke fitting op het plan
nl.Check the watts and the switch groups: Controleer het watt en de schakelgroepen
nl.Check the dimmers and the drivers: Controleer de dimmers en de drivers
nl.Match the lamp type with the client: Stem het lamptype af op de klant
nl.Send the plan to the electrician: Stuur het plan naar de elektricien
nl.Check the first fix on site: Controleer de eerste oplossing ter plaatse
nl.Confirm the metres with the workroom: Bevestig de meters bij de werkkamer
nl.Add the pattern repeat and the waste: Voeg de patroonherhaling en de afval toe
nl.Confirm the stock with the vendor: Bevestig de voorraad bij de leverancier
nl.Send the fabric to the workroom: Stuur de stof naar de werkkamer
nl.Close all items awaiting approval: Sluit alle items die wachten op goedkeuring
nl.Check that every item has a vendor: Controleer of elk item een leverancier heeft
nl.Check the quantities against the plans: Controleer de hoeveelheden aan de hand van de plannen
nl.Check the lead times against the schedul: Controleer de doorlooptijden ten opzichte van het schema
nl.Total the specification and the margin: Tel de specificatie en de marge bij elkaar op
nl.Get the client signature on the frozen s: Haal de handtekening van de klant op het bevroren schema
nl.Freeze the schedule; changes go through: Bevries het schema; Wijzigingen verlopen via een wijzigingsopdracht
nl.Specified against budget by project type: Gespecificeerd ten opzichte van het budget per projecttype
nl.Specified value by project status: Opgegeven waarde op basis van projectstatus
nl.Open Start and type your studio name and: Open Start en typ uw studionaam en uw eigen limieten in de gele cellen: opslag, reserve, doelmarge, itemmargeaandeel, weken met lange doorlooptijd, monsterdagen en afvalaandeel.
nl.Check Projects, Rooms (Room budgets) and: Controleer projecten, kamers (Kamerbudgetten) en leveranciers. Ze bevatten de projecten, de goedgekeurde kamerbudgetten en de leveranciers die op elk ander blad worden opgezocht.
nl.Fill Mark-up rules with the standard and: Vul Regels voor opmaak in met de standaard en de minimale opslag van elke categorie en de afrondingsstap; Kortingsniveaus met de extra kortingen die elke leverancier geeft.
nl.Enter each item on FF&E schedule: projec: Voer elk item in op meubilair, armaturen en uitrustingschema: project, kamer, leverancier, aantal, catalogusprijs, handelskorting en toeslag. Eenheidskosten, klantprijs, marge en de cheques worden ingevuld.
nl.Watch Room budgets and Project budgets:: Bekijk Kamerbudgetten en Projectbudgetten: het opgegeven totaal, wat er nog over is, de controle over het budget en de reserve-update bij elk item dat u toevoegt.
nl.Use Budget by category and Allowances to: Gebruik Begroting per categorie en Toeslagen om de specificatie te vergelijken met de categorieaandelen en met de met de klant overeengekomen vergoeding.
nl.Log asks on Specification approvals, sam: Log vragen in op Specificatiegoedkeuringen, voorbeelden op Afwerking en monsters en vastgelopen items op Decisions. Dagen wachten en de controles laten zien wat we moeten achtervolgen.
nl.Record each Substitutions row and each A: Noteer elke vervangingsrij en elke optie voor alternatieven, zodat het prijs-, marge- en doorlooptijdeffect duidelijk is voordat u naar de klant schrijft.
nl.Keep Dimensions, Lighting schedule and F: Houd Afmetingen, Verlichtingsschema en Stof schema up-to-date voor maten, watt, meters en besteldatums.
nl.Use the 14 calculators for prices, mark-: Gebruik de 14 calculators voor prijzen, toeslagen, kamer- en categoriebudgetten, vervangingen, hoeveelheidsniveaus, stof, vloerbedekking, verlichting, afronding, bezuinigingen, de reserve en wat als.
nl.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Druk 10 vellen en 10 documenten af, volg 10 checklists en tik op een berichtlink om een sms te sturen met de details al geschreven.
nl.Read the Specification Dashboard and Cha: Lees elke week de Specificatiedashboard en de grafieken: opgegeven waarde, marge, kamers boven budget, vervangingen, monsters en wachtende items.
nl.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Alle keuzelijsten in dit bestand. Wijzig hier een item en de wijziging wordt op elk werkblad doorgevoerd.
nl.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Wordt bijgewerkt vanuit je werkbladen. Wijzig het jaar om terug te kijken.
nl.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Kies in de gele cel; de rest wordt automatisch ingevuld. Klaar om af te drukken.
nl.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Pas de tekst hier aan; woorden tussen {accolades} worden ingevuld vanuit elke rij. De koppelingen staan in de tabellen.
nl.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Kies een registratie: voor elke stap wordt de uiterste datum berekend. Maak voor elke registratie een kopie van dit werkblad.
nl.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Actuele grafieken op basis van je werkbladen. Kies in de gele cellen en alle grafieken en meters worden automatisch vernieuwd.
